ops.oldText: for a period of sixty (60) days from the Effective Date, but in no event not later than December 31, 1999 (the "Warranty Period")
ops.newText: for a period of twelve (12) months from the Effective Date (the "Warranty Period")

ops.text: Commerce One further warrants that (a) all services provided under this Agreement (the "Services") will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner; (b) the Software and each deliverable will conform to the Documentation; (c) the Services will conform to the Documentation for a period of 90 days from performance of the Services; and (d) Commerce One will comply with all applicable laws. For breach of the warranties in this paragraph, Commerce One shall repair the non-conforming Software, deliverable or Services.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the product warranty to twelve (12) months and deleted the December 31, 1999 sunset, and added a short warranty that the Services are performed in a professional and workmanlike manner, that the Software and deliverables conform to the Documentation, a 90-day Services period measured from performance, an express repair remedy and compliance with laws. This is our preferred warranty position; 90 days for software with a 30-day Services period would be our fallback.
proposal.summary: Extend the software warranty to 12 months, delete the fixed 1999 expiry, and add a professional and workmanlike Services warranty with a 90-day Services period from performance, express repair remedy and compliance with laws.
